name: Ohio Grade 8 · Pythagorean reasoning and converse

questions.text: Side lengths are 25, 60, 65, with 65 longest. Compare 25² + 60² with 65².
questions.explanation: The converse identifies a right triangle exactly when the sum of the two smaller squares equals the largest square.

questions.text: Squares on the legs of a right triangle have areas 625 and 3600. What is the area of the square on the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse square’s area equals the sum of the leg-square areas.
